nodes.name: Google Raw Check
nodes.notes: Verified working: raw events.list with timeMin/timeMax returns 200 where the bundled Google Calendar node (n8n 2.44.4) 400s on any filtered query. Replace REPLACE_WITH_TEST_CALENDAR_ID with the full calendar id (hash + @group.calendar.google.com). Authentication = Predefined Credential Type > Google Calendar OAuth2 API > your Google Calendar account. Settings: Always Output Data ON, On Error = Continue (using Error Output).
